data.name: Kumaran
data.gender_notes: Kumaran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kumaran is a name that holds significant importance in Hindu mythology. It is the name of the younger brother of Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya or Subramaniam. Kumaran is revered for his bravery and wisdom, making it an ideal name for a baby boy. In Hindu tradition, he is often depicted carrying a spear and vel, symbolizing strength and power.
data.etymology: Kumaran belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Younger brother of God Murugan.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kumaran total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: Kumaran represents the divine qualities of bravery, wisdom, and youthfulness. As a name, it is believed to bring blessings of strength, intelligence, and long life to the child. Additionally, the name reminds us of the Hindu god Murugan, who embodies these qualities and inspires us to strive for moral and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kumaran symbolizes youthfulness, purity, and the embodiment of the god Murugan or Subramanya. It is a name revered for its association with love, courage, and divine protection.
